scenario_generation_enabled.description: Allow instructors to generate AI scenarios from the Scenario Studio.

ai_scenario_narration_enabled.description: System speaks the scenario introduction and hints aloud during a run.

ai_debrief_speech_enabled.description: When no human debrief is detected in the session transcript, the AI reads the debriefing report aloud.

instructor_voice_input_enabled.description: Allow instructors to speak their own scenario; system transcribes and parses it.

outcome_prediction_enabled.description: Before a scenario runs, system predicts expected outcomes and benchmarks actual performance.

gamification_enabled.description: Enable XP, badges, and leaderboard for scenario completions.

server_side_tts_enabled.description: Generate TTS audio on the server (gTTS) instead of browser Web Speech API. Requires internet access.

video_role_recognition_enabled.description: [Phase 2] Activate camera feed for per-person role recognition during live scenarios.
